lead.headline: Wilson, Likely and Coker all flopped — and you still lead by 47.9
lead.deck: Every starter is locked; Love and Denver are still playing. When the week rolls, Allen goes back in at quarterback.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Garrett Wilson drew three targets and 4.6 points behind a rookie who had 115 yards, Isaiah Likely caught two passes for 12 in J.J. McCarthy's first Giants start, and Jalen Coker managed 1.9 on the bench in a 43-13 rout. None of it cost you: AVIATO lead JuiceJam 88.96 to 41.02 with Jordan Love and the Broncos D/ST still playing, and ESPN gives you 73%. Ollie Gordon carried 25 times for 103 and a touchdown, so the bye fill over Kamara won. Nothing is left to set. Next week Likely, Fairbairn and Kamara are on bye; Allen returns to the QB slot, and Tuesday picks a tight end — Hockenson heads the list.
